name: auth/status
reason: The sign-in screen asks whether this backend needs setup and which doors are open, before anyone has a token. It reads the settings row and answers three booleans and the workspace's name.

name: auth/setup
reason: An empty backend has no accounts, so the first admin has no token to sign in with. It writes and mints only with the backend's SETUP_TOKEN, which nobody but the deployer holds, and only until a settings row exists.
